item.text: The installed AV code includes draft cost, but the supplied dispatch analysis shows that AV can increase padded draft work. The sampler fusion is a narrower candidate; host and router changes still need evidence that the same work runs locally.

      "quote": "draft_cost_ms[len(req_ids)]",
      "claim": "The installed AV objective already includes draft and verification costs; adding a draft-cost term alone would duplicate existing functionality.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "The controller uses stale confidence products to estimate accepted tokens. Its denominator adds a draft cost indexed by request count to verification costs indexed by candidate token budget. Cost tables snap to profiled sizes within the capture range and interpolate above the configured limit.",
      "reported_result": "Static implementation evidence: the chosen budget maximizes estimated accepted tokens divided by combined cost. No AV-on execution or performance result is supplied.",
      "transfer_inference": "First check whether those table indices represent actual post-DP target and draft graph dispatch. Reuse C24 results when available; do not duplicate its pending timing. Any correction should address demonstrated cost-model error rather than introduce another controller.",
      "limitations": "Calibration coverage, runtime confidence quality, actual dispatch and H200 gain are unknown. The draft term is constant across candidate budgets even though downstream draft padding can vary. C03 failed promotion according to the task; this source does not provide its measurements."
